mapper.select: SELECT count(1) FROM ods_user_prepare_parent_record_diversion oupprd INNER JOIN dim_user_info dui on (oupprd.user_id = dui.user_id) WHERE oupprd.dates = #{dates}

SELECT duoq.id, oupprd.dates, dui.user_id, dui.last_version `version`, dui.pkg, dui.country, oupprd.prepare_parent_user_id parent_user_id, oupprd.create_time FROM ods_user_prepare_parent_record_diversion oupprd INNER JOIN dim_user_info dui on (oupprd.user_id = dui.user_id) LEFT JOIN dwd_user_share_record duoq on (duoq.dates = dui.dates and duoq.user_id = dui.user_id and duoq.pkg = dui.pkg and duoq.country = dui.country) WHERE oupprd.dates = #{dates} limit #{startRows}, #{rows}
